name: pdf
description: PDF is a fixed-layout scientific delivery primitive for reading, extracting, creating, merging, splitting, rotating, watermarking, OCR, and validating PDF documents. Use it for reports, supplementary materials, forms, print distribution, and archival handoff.
capabilities: Extract text, tables, images, and metadata from PDFs.
Create, merge, split, rotate, watermark, encrypt, or OCR PDF outputs.
Preserve page layout and inspect the delivered file.
requirements: PDF parser or generator such as pypdf, pdfplumber, or reportlab.
OCR engine and rasterizer when processing scanned documents.
